search.query: index=scoreboard_admin ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Number=* user!=admin NOT Result=Bonus NOT Result=Hint | stats count as Attempts count(eval(Result="Correct")) as Correct count(eval(Result="Incorrect")) as Incorrect dc(Team) as TeamsAttempted by ctf_id Number | append [ | inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | eval Attempts=0,Correct=0,Incorrect=0,TeamsAttempted=0 | fields ctf_id Number Question BasePoints Attempts Correct Incorrect TeamsAttempted ] | stats max(Attempts) as Attempts max(Correct) as Correct max(Incorrect) as Incorrect max(TeamsAttempted) as TeamsAttempted last(Question) as Question last(BasePoints) as BasePoints by ctf_id Number | eval CorrectPct=if(Attempts>0,round((Correct/Attempts)*100,1),0) | sort Number | table Number Question BasePoints Attempts Correct Incorrect CorrectPct TeamsAttempted
